title: RentGuard Renters Policy Lapse-Length Charge on the Cure
content:
The cure on a RentGuard Renters Policy cancelled for nonpayment carries a lapse-length charge set by how long the policy has stood cancelled.

## Charge

The calendar days from the cancellation date, recorded on the policy as its closed date, to today are counted. When they are more than 20, 5.00 is added to the cure; when they are more than 10 but no more than 20, 2.50 is added; when they are 10 or fewer, nothing is added.

| Calendar days from the cancellation date to today | Added to the cure |
|---|---|
| more than 20 | 5.00 |
| more than 10 but no more than 20 | 2.50 |
| 10 or fewer | nothing |

## Boundaries

- 10 days: nothing is added; 11 days: 2.50 is added.
- 20 days: 2.50 is added; 21 days: 5.00 is added.

## Dated illustration (hypothetical dates)

For a hypothetical policy whose closed date is 4 March:

| Today | Days counted | Added to the cure |
|---|---|---|
| 14 March | 10 | nothing |
| 15 March | 11 | 2.50 |
| 24 March | 20 | 2.50 |
| 25 March | 21 | 5.00 |
